releaseNotes: Redesigned ScanDrop UI with Electric Blue / Deep Navy / Ice Blue / Golden Yellow brand palette, flowing wave canvas & deep-navy glowing sidebar; added Visual Page Manager for PDF & Word documents (pick exact pages, range filter 1-3,5, drag-reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, send pages to Holding Tray); added per-file page ranges in Merge & Print All; added global Ctrl+Z Undo & multi-step Undo/Redo across Page Manager, Image Canvas & Merge.
